passages.note: Wilmeth is listed as a co-sponsor of HB2853, which the governor signed as Chapter 388.
House Third Reading vote tally shows Wilmeth voted Y on final passage of HB2853.

passages.provision_quote: "qualified student" includes a resident of this state who both: 1. Is eligible to enroll in a public school in this state in any of the following: ( a ) A preschool program for children with disabilities. ( b ) A kindergarten program. ( c ) Any of grades one through twelve. 2. Does not otherwise qualify for an Arizona empowerment scholarship account pursuant to this chapter.
passages.note: Chapter 388 adds 15-2401.01, making any public-school-eligible student a qualified student for an ESA, without an income cap.

rows.reasoning: Wilmeth co-sponsored and voted Yes on HB2853 (2022), which added section 15-2401.01 making any resident eligible to enroll in a public preschool, kindergarten, or grades one through twelve a qualified student for an Arizona empowerment scholarship account, with no income cap and no exclusion of religious qualified schools. This matches the rung text 'Providing universal vouchers so that education funding follows the student to any school — public, private, or religious — chosen by the family.'
